description: Case definitions for a NEW CLI snapshot, not mutations of the original recovery contract/GUI results. Each mapping is explicitly narrower than complete capability parity. Execution uses independent synthetic input and actual CLI/unit processes; no official Config GUI is run.

capability_mappings.condition_scope: Signed O values -1.25/2.75 and explicit zero; parameter direction; positive/negative nonzero decimal underflow; invalid NaN/scientific input; dry-run.
MinSoc zero/100 endpoints, omitted versus explicit-zero inspection, rejection of -1/101 and positive/negative nonzero decimal underflow.
MaxSpwr5.5/0 storage; negative and positive/negative nonzero-underflow rejection without zero-runtime interpretation.
Twelve direct existing slots including canonical native 8-4-4-16 IDs; full-record move to2; sparse shape rejection; dry-run.
Native 8-4-4-16/RFC 8-4-4-4-12 identity aliases, case-insensitive selection, exact spelling preservation, duplicate and misplaced-dash rejection.
U=true survives rated-zero edits and reorder; unused slots retain omitted U/false.
Existing name changes to CLI & renamed with XML escaping and intact unknown/icon/wire data.
Native-backed name setter changes absent Ncu to true; not GUI transition proof.
Analog setter and digital/default omission on an existing slot.
Native-backed mode setter changes absent Anc to true; not GUI transition proof.
OIdx remains0 when native/RFC identity is moved to priority2; twelve explicit unique associations required.
Default RT60 omission, edits30/86400 seconds, rejection29/86401.
Integer2 and -1 minutes to120/-60 seconds; zero omission; checked overflow; dry-run.
Daily0/1440 integer minutes to omitted0/86400 seconds; reject -1/1441.
Editable Sunset0/Dusk1 and native-only24:00 label for untouched tpR27; Sunrise edit unsupported.
Zero SwPwr substitution, rated-zero switch copy, above-rated values, and positive/negative nonzero-underflow rejection before substitution.
Rated4 zero-switch copy, explicit rated0 omission with U=true, and positive/negative nonzero-underflow rejection.
Preservation-only: existing ico reference survives RFC and native-ID load fields/reorder.
Storage-derived unused condition !U || MaxPwr<=0 on unused/default and connected rated-zero slots.

cases.condition: Signed O values -1.25/2.75 and explicit zero; parameter direction; positive/negative nonzero decimal underflow; invalid NaN/scientific input; dry-run.
cases.procedure: Run tests/ux/energy-manager2/run-cli-cases.py on the built local lox binary: Set O=-1.25,2.75,0; inspect get-params direction; reject NaN/1e3 and +/-('0.'+399 zeros+'1') with source snapshots; run dry-run. Execute the separate parser regression for incoming parameter wire retention.
cases.expected: O is parameter/P; signed values persist; explicit zero omits Def; nonzero underflow is rejected before omission; unrelated data survives and rejected/dry-run edits write no file. Parser proof is direction/wire retention only, not runtime behavior.

cases.condition: Scalar API signed/zero O, metadata=P, positive/negative nonzero-underflow rejection, duplicate bindings; simulator parser O parameter incoming wire.
cases.procedure: Execute cargo test --bin lox --test config_integration energy_ -- --nocapture and cargo test -p lox-sim --lib parser::tests::energy_manager_offset_parameter_retains_incoming_wire -- --nocapture; inspect named assertions: config_edit::energy_tests::energy_signed_offset_is_parameter_and_bounds_are_atomic, config_edit::energy_tests::energy_scalar_edits_preserve_entire_other_records_and_fail_ambiguous_bindings, config_edit::energy_tests::energy_nonzero_decimal_underflow_fails_atomically, parser::tests::energy_manager_offset_parameter_retains_incoming_wire
cases.expected: Signed O/default omission roundtrip; +/-('0.'+399 zeros+'1') fails numeric_underflow without DOM mutation; parser O is Parameter retaining -1.25 default and Source.AQ incoming wire, without runtime simulation.

cases.condition: MinSoc zero/100 endpoints, omitted versus explicit-zero inspection, rejection of -1/101 and positive/negative nonzero decimal underflow.
cases.procedure: Run tests/ux/energy-manager2/run-cli-cases.py on the built local lox binary: Inspect baseline; set MinSoc=100 then0; reject -1/101 and +/-('0.'+399 zeros+'1') with byte snapshots.
cases.expected: Stored0 differs from omission;100 persists and zero omits Def; out-of-range and nonzero-underflow inputs fail without mutation or default omission.

cases.condition: MinSoc0/100, -1/101, omitted storage and positive/negative nonzero-underflow.
cases.procedure: Execute cargo test --bin lox --test config_integration energy_ -- --nocapture; inspect named assertions: config_edit::energy_tests::energy_signed_offset_is_parameter_and_bounds_are_atomic, config_edit::energy_tests::energy_inspection_distinguishes_omission_and_unknown_binding, config_edit::energy_tests::energy_nonzero_decimal_underflow_fails_atomically
cases.expected: Endpoints succeed, invalid bounds/nonzero-underflow preserve bytes, and stored0 remains distinct from omitted default0.

cases.condition: MaxSpwr5.5/0 storage; negative and positive/negative nonzero-underflow rejection without zero-runtime interpretation.
cases.procedure: Run tests/ux/energy-manager2/run-cli-cases.py on the built local lox binary: Set MaxSpwr5.5 then0; reject -1 and +/-('0.'+399 zeros+'1') against byte snapshots.
cases.expected: Nonnegative power persists; explicit zero omits Def; negative/nonzero-underflow input cannot mutate or become a zero sentinel. No runtime meaning is inferred.

cases.condition: MaxSpwr5.5/0, negative input and positive/negative nonzero-underflow.
cases.procedure: Execute cargo test --bin lox --test config_integration energy_ -- --nocapture; inspect named assertions: config_edit::energy_tests::energy_signed_offset_is_parameter_and_bounds_are_atomic, config_edit::energy_tests::energy_nonzero_decimal_underflow_fails_atomically
cases.expected: 5.5 reads back, explicit0 omits; negative/nonzero-underflow fail without changing bytes or applying a zero sentinel; runtime remains untested.

cases.condition: Twelve direct existing slots including canonical native 8-4-4-16 IDs; full-record move to2; sparse shape rejection; dry-run.
cases.procedure: Run tests/ux/energy-manager2/run-cli-cases.py on the built local lox binary: Inspect12 rows in RFC and canonical synthetic.Loxone native fixtures; edit an existing native Id and move using its RFC alias; compare whole attributes/wires; reject malformed/duplicate/sparse shapes and dry-run move.
cases.expected: Priority follows XML order; complete records/unknown nested children/interleaved node/wire UUIDs survive; no rows created/deleted; unsafe or dry-run edits do not write.

cases.condition: Complete record moves around interleaved nodes plus canonical native fixture edit and native/RFC alias reorder; invalid shapes.
cases.procedure: Execute cargo test --bin lox --test config_integration energy_ -- --nocapture; inspect named assertions: config_edit::energy_tests::energy_reorder_preserves_whole_records_unknown_children_and_wire_spellings, config_edit::energy_tests::energy_unsupported_shapes_and_ambiguous_ids_do_not_mutate, config_edit::energy_tests::energy_native_ids_and_aliases_preserve_records
cases.expected: Full XMLNodes/attributes/native Id spellings retain identity and OIdx; reverse reorder restores bytes; malformed/mixed-duplicate/sparse edits cannot mutate.

cases.condition: Native 8-4-4-16/RFC 8-4-4-4-12 identity aliases, case-insensitive selection, exact spelling preservation, duplicate and misplaced-dash rejection.
cases.procedure: Run tests/ux/energy-manager2/run-cli-cases.py on the built local lox binary: Use canonical native fixture: edit native Id, reorder through RFC alias, select uppercase hex alias and reject a mixed native/RFC duplicate plus7-5-4-16 malformed selector.
cases.expected: Both strict spellings select the same binary identity; stored native spelling remains exact; mixed-spelling duplicates/malformed dash placement fail atomically. U is never identity.

cases.condition: Canonical native Id selected natively, by RFC alias and uppercase hex; malformed7-5-4-16 and mixed native/RFC duplicate rejection.
cases.procedure: Execute cargo test --bin lox --test config_integration energy_ -- --nocapture; inspect named assertions: config_edit::energy_tests::energy_reorder_preserves_whole_records_unknown_children_and_wire_spellings, config_edit::energy_tests::energy_unsupported_shapes_and_ambiguous_ids_do_not_mutate, config_edit::energy_tests::energy_native_ids_and_aliases_preserve_records
cases.expected: Accepted aliases resolve one persistent identity while native spelling remains exact; malformed dash placement and binary-equivalent duplicates reject atomically.

cases.condition: U=true survives rated-zero edits and reorder; unused slots retain omitted U/false.
cases.procedure: Run tests/ux/energy-manager2/run-cli-cases.py on the built local lox binary: Inspect unused slots; configure first load, set rated power0 and reorder it.
cases.expected: U stays exact true on connected zero-rated load, unused rows remain false/omitted, and U is not offered as an enable setter.

cases.condition: Connected U=true remains after MaxPwr0; omitted U becomes effective false; UUID-valued U shape is rejected.
cases.procedure: Execute cargo test --bin lox --test config_integration energy_ -- --nocapture; inspect named assertions: config_edit::energy_tests::energy_power_zero_substitution_and_above_rated_are_allowed, config_edit::energy_tests::energy_unsupported_shapes_and_ambiguous_ids_do_not_mutate
cases.expected: Used true spelling survives rated-zero edit, omission remains false, and invalid U cannot mutate the editor.

cases.condition: Existing name changes to CLI & renamed with XML escaping and intact unknown/icon/wire data.

cases.condition: Native-backed name setter changes absent Ncu to true; not GUI transition proof.

cases.condition: Direct native name setter starts from omitted Ncu.

cases.condition: Native-backed mode setter changes absent Anc to true; not GUI transition proof.

cases.condition: Direct native mode setter starts from omitted Anc.
